description: Reports which newer HTTP protocols a site advertises: HTTP/3 (h3) and older draft or HTTP/2 alternatives in its Alt-Svc response header, and the Alt-Svc max-age. This is what the server announces, not a TLS ALPN negotiation: the fetch this tool makes cannot choose the protocol, so a site that negotiates but does not send Alt-Svc will show as not advertised. Choose this tool for: Reports which newer HTTP protocols a site advertises. Close alternatives on this server: security_security_headers (Checks the live HTTP response headers of a site's home page); security_cookie_security (Lists the cookies a site sets on its public home page). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_tls_alpn_detector
title: Reports which newer HTTP protocols a site advertises
